name: NearFear
description: Discover and rate scary places near you.

screens.name: MapScreen
screens.purpose: Display nearby scary places on a map.

features.name: map-display
features.description: Shows scary locations on a map with color-coded fear ratings.

features.name: location-tracking
features.description: Tracks user location to display nearby places.

features.name: marker-details
features.description: Displays place details when a map marker is tapped.

screens.layout: Full screen MapView with markers and callouts.

screens.name: AddPlaceScreen
screens.purpose: Submit a new scary place to the app.

features.name: place-submission
features.description: Allows users to submit new locations with name, location, and fear rating.

features.name: fear-tags
features.description: Add 'fear tags' (e.g., 'haunted', 'creepy alley') to the location.

features.name: location-picker
features.description: Uses map to select the place's coordinates.

screens.layout: Form with text inputs, map picker, and tag selection.

screens.name: ChallengesScreen
screens.purpose: View and create fear challenges for friends.

features.name: challenge-list
features.description: Displays a list of active and completed fear challenges.

features.name: challenge-creation
features.description: Allows users to create new challenges with a place and description.

features.name: challenge-details
features.description: Show details about a specific challenge.

screens.layout: List of challenges with add button and detail view.

screens.name: ProfileScreen
screens.purpose: Manage user profile settings and view activity.

features.name: settings-access
features.description: Provides access to app settings and preferences.

features.name: user-activity
features.description: Shows user activity like submitted places and completed challenges.

screens.layout: Profile information with settings button and activity list.

screens.name: PlaceDetailsScreen
screens.purpose: View details and reviews of a specific place.

features.name: place-details
features.description: Displays detailed information about a selected place.

features.name: review-display
features.description: Shows user reviews and ratings for the place.

features.name: review-submission
features.description: Allows users to submit their own reviews and ratings.

screens.layout: Place details with reviews section and submission form.
